title: Pure WAKE CUP!

allow.Book of Moon: Generic Quick-Play that turns a monster face-down; it only carries the "Book of" name, and resets Flip monsters for another FLIP.
allow.Book of Taiyou: Generic Spell that flips a face-down monster face-up; it only carries the "Book of" name, and triggers Earl's or Whirlwind Weasel's FLIP on your own turn.

summary: Pure WAKE CUP! Flip-control strategy, revolving around caffeinated coffee beasties that summon themselves face-down and manipulate battle positions. Paired with high-impact generic Flip lock monsters, the deck triggers game-ending floodgates on the opponent's turn via Quick Effect flips.

summary.title: Starters
points: WAKE CUP! Kuro reveals itself from the hand to search any WIND Flip monster (such as Whirlwind Weasel or Sonic Jammer), and while face-up on the field, can flip a face-down monster into face-up Defense Position as a Quick Effect during either turn.
WAKE CUP! Macchia reveals itself and another Flip monster in hand to Special Summon both monsters in face-down Defense Position.
WAKE CUP! Mocha Special Summons itself from hand while you control a face-down monster, and flips itself face-down during each End Phase.
WAKE CUP! Earl discards a Flip monster from hand to Special Summon itself, and when flipped face-up, sends face-up cards the opponent controls to the GY up to the number of Flip monsters you control.

summary.title: Opening: Kuro + Macchia + Weasel
steps: Activate WAKE CUP! Kuro in hand, revealing itself to search Whirlwind Weasel from your Deck.
Activate WAKE CUP! Macchia in hand, revealing Macchia and Whirlwind Weasel to Special Summon both face-down to your field.
Normal Summon WAKE CUP! Kuro (or summon Mocha next to your face-down monsters).
Set Book of Moon and pass to the opponent's turn.
During the opponent's Draw Phase or Standby Phase, activate Kuro's Quick Effect to flip Whirlwind Weasel face-up.
Whirlwind Weasel's FLIP effect resolves, completely preventing the opponent from activating Spell or Trap Cards for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: Flip Locks & Floodgates
points: Whirlwind Weasel is a WIND Flip monster that prevents the opponent from activating any Spell or Trap Cards or their effects for the entire turn when flipped face-up.
Sonic Jammer is a WIND Flip monster that prevents the opponent from activating Spell Cards until the end of their next turn when flipped face-up.
Guard Dog is an EARTH Flip monster that completely locks both players out of Special Summoning monsters for the rest of the turn when flipped face-up.
Mahjong Munia Maidens draws 1 card and discards 1 card when flipped face-up, then changes itself back to face-down Defense Position.

summary.title: Spells & Utility
points: Book of Moon provides versatile interruption by flipping an opponent's monster face-down, or turns your own Flip monsters face-down again to reuse their effects.
Book of Taiyou immediately flips a face-down monster into face-up Attack Position on your turn, triggering your Flip monsters on demand.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Prediction Princess Ritual engine is left out of this profile to preserve a lean, pure WAKE CUP! package focused entirely on low-Level beasties and Quick Effect flips.
